availableBaseline.title: ספר טובי
availableBaseline.edition: Adolf Neubauer, 1878; medieval Hebrew manuscript tradition based on Constantinople1516 with manuscript variants; not Hiller’s Greek translation.
availableBaseline.completeness: Thirteen actual sections א–יג followed by a final colophon. This is presented as the whole Neubauer text; it is not the selected14-chapter long recension. Do not invent chapter14 or align by chapter numbers alone.
availableBaseline.vocalization: Main narrative is unpointed; cannot supply selected print niqqud.

sample.context: Long recension1:1–3, lower half of page.
differentWording: Print begins ספר דברי טובי; Neubauer begins זה ספר טובי.
Print1:3 has בדרכי האמת ובצדקות and גמלתי; Neubauer has בדרך תמים, צדקות רבות וחסדים טובים, שעשיתי.
Genealogical names differ and must not be repaired from the alternate edition.
sample.safeUse: Passage/topic lookup and individually confirmed common words only. No sentence, verse numbering, recension, or vowel-point transfer.

availableBaseline.title: כתובים אחרונים/יהודית
availableBaseline.edition: כתובים אחרונים; catalog identifies1830first edition and1863reissue. This body page does not pin a scan edition itself.
availableBaseline.chapterNavigation: All16chapter paragraphs א–טז are embedded on one page, without chapter headings or numbered verse elements; use page URL, not invented chapter subpages.
availableBaseline.completeness: All16chapter starts and concluding lifetime/death narrative are present; not independently certified verse-by-verse against Frankel print.
availableBaseline.vocalization: Mixed: chapter1 is pointed, chapter2 is predominantly unpointed; cannot supply Simon niqqud.

differentWording: Simon begins בשנת שתים־עשרה לנבוכדנאצר; Frankel begins ויהי בשנת שתים עשרה למלך נבוכדנצר.
Simon identifies king over Assyria in Nineveh; Frankel says אשר ישב בנינוה and adds לאלהים and הבירה היא אקבתנה.
Simon spells הולופרנים in chapter2; Frankel uses הלופרנש.
Simon’s printed chapter3 begins the coastlands’ fear passage; Frankel places that material at the end of chapter2.
sample.safeUse: Location of shared events/words only. Exact clauses, spelling, printed combined labels, chapter boundaries, and niqqud must come from Simon print.
